title: AncientCity Locator
description: A mod that makes finding ancient cities easier.
body:
# **AncientCity Locator**

This mod makes finding ancient cities easier by introducing a new item called the Ancient Compass.

---
## Usage

      Right-clicking it locks onto the nearest ancient city.

      ![Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/174b3bcf9ab841c11e4167e10ddede3eceef4792.gif)

---
## Crafting

      ![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8f04118b9773fc052926c1607f17364bd4ac27e.png)

      *The Ancient Compass can also be found in ancient city chests.*

---
## Versions

      The mod works 26.1+, and I have no plans to make it available for earlier versions.

      [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required.
